signature.objects: PLC rack and two joined setting nodes
signature.composition: rack left and two large connected squares right

prompt: Create one SQUARE 1:1 simple icon on white for industrial PLC configuration attributes. At left draw a dark-blue industrial PLC module: a rectangle with three large white module slots and a bold lower strip of three large terminals. At right draw two LARGE separate orange square setting nodes, one above the other, connected to the rack by a single thick orange bracket. The two nodes must have a very wide white gap so they remain distinct at small sizes. No letters, no tiny details, no gamepad. Thick flat shapes, generous margin, no shadow.
